coder_notes: Registered phase is PHASE4 (screening step S3 handled by script). Arms 1 and 2 are registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but function as experimental arms; arm 3 is the registered NO_INTERVENTION standard-of-care control. Exclusion criterion 22 admits IDH-wildtype glioblastoma but also lists grade 3/4 IDH-mutant astrocytoma only as a post-surgery histology exclusion; no IDH entry requirement is coded. Atezolizumab immuno-PET tracer listed as diagnostic agent because the protocol text says immuno-PET is performed in the pembrolizumab arms (summary says all patients). PD-L1 row coded pharmacodynamic (imaging of PD-L1 change), not an eligibility biomarker.
